finding.summary: A new request_takeover can set intent after handoff durably commits manager control but before handoff reopens the fence. The unconditional reopen erases the newer intent, allowing automatic dispatch after the user request.
finding.required_behavior: Bind handoff reopen to the intent generation observed at handoff start; a concurrent newer takeover generation must survive. Add a deterministic handoff/new-takeover/automatic-dispatch schedule.

interpretation_note: The existing transport design uses the write-locked atomic claim as the submission linearization point. A claim that wins before revoke is already in-flight even if socket bytes follow the invocation; it remains unknown/delivered and is never canceled or replayed.
scope_incident: The excluded scripted-OMP suite is not credited; read-only process inspection found zero residue.

acceptance.C-AC-18: not met due lost-intent handoff race; external OMP pending
